name: Winter WestSide Events 2022
information:
#### 3x3x3 Cube will *not* be held at this competition!

Saturday will feature side events and Sunday will feature blindfolded events. The main event is clock.

Competitors should read the [Competitor Information](#22549-competitor-information) tab, and new competitors should read the [New Competitors](#23066-new-competitors) tab. Spectators should read the [Guests](#22552-guests) tab. All attendees are required to read the [COVID-19 Safety](#22550-covid-19-safety) tab.

Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/SoCalCubing) to hear about competitions in Southern California before registration opens and keep in touch with cubers in the area!
